name: org.machanism.machai:bindex-core
description: Bindex Core is a Java 17 library for creating, validating, storing, discovering, and integrating Bindex metadata: structured descriptors of reusable software artifacts for GenAI-assisted application assembly. It provides a MongoDB-backed repository, semantic vector search over classification embeddings, natural-language library recommendation, dependency traversal, and typed Bindex v2 schema support. Its AI-facing functional tools retrieve a descriptor from registered coordinates, an HTTP(S) URL, or a project-relative file; recommend libraries from a natural-language requirement; and register descriptors from files, URLs, or in-memory JSON. It also exposes the Bindex v2 JSON Schema and a generation prompt for agent and MCP integrations. Bindex Core is intended for Java applications, the Machai MCP Server, Ghostwriter workflows, and Maven-based automation that need governed library discovery, metadata registration, and AI-ready integration guidance.

constructors.description: Creates the AI-facing Bindex tool set. An MCP-capable host discovers its annotated operations to retrieve metadata, recommend libraries, and register Bindex descriptors. Repository access is initialized lazily from the host Configurator.

examples.description: Create the tool provider when embedding Bindex operations in a Java AI host. The host supplies configuration when it invokes a tool.

constructors.description: Creates the core recommendation and registration service with a repository and host configuration. Picker classifies natural-language requests, creates embeddings, searches matching Bindex records, and saves descriptors with their embeddings.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexRepository repository = new org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.MongoBindexRepository(configurator);
org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.Picker picker = new org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.Picker(repository, configurator);
examples.description: Construct the lower-level Java API when application code needs direct control of Bindex persistence and semantic recommendation.

features.name: get-bindex
features.signature: public org.machanism.machai.schema.Bindex org.machanism.machai.bindex.ai.tools.BindexFunctionTools.getBindex(java.lang.String id, java.lang.String query, java.io.File projectDir, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator configurator) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Functional AI tool that retrieves Bindex metadata by registered Bindex ID, direct HTTP(S) descriptor URL, or a file:// path resolved within the project directory. An optional GraphQL-style selection query reduces the returned top-level fields; nested selections are parsed but nested values are returned as complete objects.

examples.snippet: get-bindex(id: "org.machanism.machai:bindex-core:1.4.0", graphql-query: "{ name version classification { languages } }")
examples.description: Ask an MCP client for the identity and classification metadata of a registered artifact while reducing the response payload.

features.name: pick-libraries
features.signature: public java.util.Collection<org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexInfo> org.machanism.machai.bindex.ai.tools.BindexFunctionTools.getRecommendedLibraries(java.lang.String prompt, double score, int vectorSearchLimits, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator configurator) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Functional AI tool that classifies a natural-language requirement, generates an embedding, and returns Bindex library recommendations meeting the requested similarity threshold. Tool defaults are a score of 0.85 and a vector-search limit of 25.

examples.snippet: pick-libraries(prompt: "I need Java components for MCP-based library discovery and semantic metadata search", score: 0.85, search-limits: 10)
examples.description: Use semantic recommendations during technical planning to find indexed libraries that fit an implementation requirement.

features.name: register-bindex
features.signature: public java.lang.String org.machanism.machai.bindex.ai.tools.BindexFunctionTools.registerBindex(java.lang.String path, java.io.File projectDir, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator configurator) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Functional AI tool that registers or updates a Bindex descriptor from an HTTP(S) URL or a file located inside the active project directory. The default file is bindex.json. It returns the repository registration identifier and rejects local paths that escape the project tree.

examples.description: Register the validated descriptor at the root of the active project so it becomes available for Bindex discovery.

features.name: register-bindex-json
features.description: Functional AI tool that registers a supplied in-memory Bindex JSON object and returns its repository identifier. Use it when an agent has already generated or obtained a schema-compliant descriptor and does not need file-based registration.

examples.description: Publish a descriptor held by an AI integration. In production, supply every required Bindex v2 field before registering it.

customizations.name: BINDEX_REPO_URL
customizations.description: MongoDB connection URI used by MongoBindexRepository. When absent, the repository falls back to its configured default connection behavior.

examples.description: Set this environment variable to direct Bindex Core to a local or managed MongoDB repository.

customizations.name: picker.classificationInstruction
customizations.description: Optional host configuration for the instruction template used to classify a natural-language request before semantic library selection.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexRepository
studs.description: Persistence and semantic-search boundary for Bindex records. Implementations retrieve descriptors, save descriptors with embedding vectors, and find relevant record summaries using classification filters and vector similarity.

examples.description: Use the MongoDB implementation supplied by this artifact, or provide another implementation when storage must be adapted.

examples.title: Run Bindex functional tools through the Machai MCP Server
examples.description: 1. Install Java 17 or later. 2. Download machai-mcp-server.jar and bindex-core.jar. 3. Configure GenAI credentials and model properties. 4. Start the server with bindex-core.jar on the classpath. 5. Connect an MCP client and invoke get-bindex, pick-libraries, register-bindex, or register-bindex-json.
examples.notes: On Windows, replace the classpath colon with a semicolon. Configure BINDEX_REPO_URL, BINDEX_USER, and BINDEX_PASSWORD when using a private or local MongoDB repository.

examples.title: Add Bindex Core to a Maven integration
examples.description: 1. Add the dependency to the application or to the gw-maven-plugin dependencies. 2. Configure a MongoDB repository and GenAI/embedding provider in the host Configurator. 3. Use BindexFunctionTools for AI-facing operations or construct Picker with MongoBindexRepository for direct Java usage.
examples.notes: After the dependency is resolved, register a validated bindex.json and use natural-language library picking to support application planning or assembly.
